Scroll-to-bottom smoke-test fixture

Top

The userscript button should be visible because there is plenty of content below.

Middle

Scrolling should keep the userscript button visible until the viewport reaches the bottom.

Near the bottom

Click the userscript button and verify that the page scrolls smoothly to the bottom.

Bottom

At the bottom, the userscript button should disappear.

Then click “Add dynamic content” above. The page grows and the userscript button should reappear.
